title: STAGE (STop And Go Extraction) C18 Tips for Desalting and Clean Up
author: Teesha C Luehr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y9pfz5n
materials: Hydrate the tip with 100 µL, Buffer A

steps.title: Prepare Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Buffer A (2% ACN with 0.1% TFA): Mix 10 mL 1% TFA, 2 mL ACN, and 88 mL Milli-Q water to make 100 mL.

Buffer B (30-80% ACN with 0.1% TFA): For general peptides (60% ACN), mix 10 mL 1% TFA, 60 mL ACN, and 30 mL Milli-Q water to make 100 mL. For immunopeptides (30% ACN), mix 10 mL 1% TFA, 30 mL ACN, and 60 mL Milli-Q water to make 100 mL.
Mass Spectrometry Buffer A (2% ACN with 0.1% FA): Use Formic Acid (FA) instead of TFA for mass spectrometry solvents.

steps.title: Assemble C18 Tips
steps.instruction: Prepare the P200 pipette tips using either C18 Empore filters or a frit with C18 powder.

substeps.instruction: Punch out a disk using a 17G flat-tipped syringe from C18 Empore filters or an SPE frit; avoid squishing the frit to prevent blockage (hammering the syringe down is recommended over twisting).
Eject the frit/filter disk into a P200 pipette tip using an unfolded paper clip.
Ensure the filter/frit is securely wedged in the bottom of the tip.

steps.title: Load and Compact C18 Powder
steps.instruction: If using a frit instead of a C18 membrane, add and pack the C18 powder.

substeps.instruction: Create a slurry by adding C18 powder to a multi-channel pipette reservoir and wetting it with methanol.
Add the C18 slurry on top of the filter/frit using a pipette (10mg of C18 powder is approximately 11mm above the frit).
Compact the slurry and remove methanol by forcing it through using a Luer lock syringe or by centrifuging the tips at 800g.

steps.title: Prepare Sample
steps.instruction: Reconstitute and acidify the sample to ensure a pH < 2.5.

substeps.instruction: If the sample is dry, reconstitute in 20 µL to 100 µL of Buffer A depending on concentration.
If the sample is aqueous, acidify with 1% TFA to a pH < 2.5.
If concentration is unknown, determine it via NanoDrop (note: 10mg C18 powder handles ~200-500µg protein from full cell lysate).

steps.title: Condition and Wash Tip
steps.instruction: Prepare the tip for sample loading.

substeps.instruction: Condition the tip with 100 µL of Buffer B (50-60% ACN with 0.1% TFA).
Wash the tip with 200 µL of 1% TFA (optional: collect flow through and store at -20°C).

steps.title: Load Sample
steps.instruction: Pass the prepared sample through the C18 tip.

substeps.instruction: Pass the reconstituted sample slowly through the tip (optional: collect flow through and store at -20°C).

steps.title: Elute and Dry Sample
steps.instruction: Recover the peptides and prepare for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Elute the sample with 2X 100 µL of Buffer B (at the selected % ACN) into a 0.5 mL microtube or a 96-well plate.
Dry the sample completely in a SpeedVac.
Reconstitute the dried sample in the Mass Spec Buffer.
